# Tymor 1.0.1
## ✨ What's new
- Start with ambience intensity set to 70% by default. - Adjust snow bed height from Thin to Thick, with room for deeper snow on the ground, windows, icons, and widgets. - Choose Small, Default, or Large fireflies.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Include running apps in the Dock width estimate so snow reaches both ends of the tray.

# Tymor 1.0
First release.
## ✨ What's new
- Bring your desktop to life with winter snow, rain, or glowing fireflies. - Snow gathers on windows, the Dock, desktop icons, widgets, and the bottom of your screen. Build snowmen or clear the ground with a snowplow. - Make a rainy day your own with optional thunder, lightning, and sound. - Move your pointer near fireflies to scatter them, or hold Option to draw them closer. - Choose wallpapers for each ambience, with full-size images downloaded when needed. - Adjust the frame rate and pause effects on battery or in Low Power Mode. Open Tymor automatically at login. - Enjoy a three-day free trial; one license covers up to three Macs. - Receive updates through Tymor’s built-in updater.
